chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Sabih, from Ali ibn Ghurab, from Abu Abdillah, from his father, said:
The one who performs i'tikaf performs it in the congregational mosque.

key_terms.الْمُتَعَكِّفُ: The one who performs i'tikaf (spiritual retreat)

ai.seo_question: Where should a Muslim perform i'tikaf according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar specifies that i'tikaf is legally valid when performed in the congregational mosque (al-Masjid al-Jami'), reflecting the Shia emphasis on communal worship spaces. It highlights the jurisprudential distinction between general mosques and the primary mosque of a city, ensuring the retreat aligns with the Prophet's and Imams' practice of seeking closeness to God within the community's spiritual center.
